+#!/usr/bin/python
+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+ANSIBLE_METADATA = {'metadata_version': '1.1', 'status': ['preview'],
+                    'supported_by': 'community'}
+
+DOCUMENTATION = '''
+---
+module: icx_logging
+version_added: "2.9"
+author: "Ansible Project"
+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX 7000 series switches
+description:
+  - Configure logging destinations, levels and facility on ICX switches.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or global logging switch.
+    type: str
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on]
+  name:
+    description: Host name or IP address for a host destination.
+    type: str
+  udp_port:
+    description: UDP port for a host destination.
+    type: int
+  facility:
+    description: Syslog facility. With C(state=absent), clear the configured facility.
+    type: str
+  level:
+    description: Buffered severity level or list of levels. Console accepts one level.
+    type: raw
+  aggregate:
+    description: List of logging settings, each with the same options as the top level.
+    type: list
+    elements: dict
+  state:
+    description: Whether the setting is enabled or removed.
+    type: str
+    choices: [present, absent]
+    default: present
+  check_running_config:
+    description: Compare with the running configuration. May also be set with ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG.
+    type: bool
+    default: true
+notes:
+  - Tested against ICX 10.1.
+'''
+
+EXAMPLES = '''
+- name: Add an IPv6 syslog host and set the facility
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: host
+    name: '2001:db8::1'
+    udp_port: 514
+    facility: local7
+
+- name: Configure several settings
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {dest: host, name: 192.0.2.10, udp_port: 514}
+      - {dest: buffered, level: [warnings, errors]}
+      - {dest: rfc5424}
+
+- name: Disable console logging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: console
+    state: absent
+'''
+
+RETURN = '''
+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the switch.
+  returned: always
+  type: list
+  sample: ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514']
+'''
+
+import re
+from copy import deepcopy
+
+from ansible.module_utils.basic import AnsibleModule, env_fallback
+from ansible.module_utils.network.common.utils import remove_default_spec, validate_ip_v6_address
+from ansible.module_utils.network.icx.icx import get_config, load_config
+
+
+LEVELS = ('emergencies', 'alerts', 'critical', 'errors', 'warnings',
+          'notifications', 'informational', 'debugging')
+DESTINATIONS = ('host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on')
+
+
+def count_terms(check, param=None):
+    """Count supplied (including false) values in a parameter mapping."""
+    return sum(check.get(key) is not None for key in (param or check))
+
+
+def check_required_if(module, spec, param):
+    """Validate destination-specific required options for an aggregate item."""
+    if spec is None:
+        spec = [('dest', 'host', ['name']), ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])]
+    for key, value, required in spec:
+        if param.get(key) == value:
+            for field in required:
+                if param.get(field) is None or param.get(field) == '':
+                    module.fail_json(msg="dest=%s requires %s" % (value, field))
+
+
+def search_obj_in_list(name, lst):
+    for item in lst:
+        if item.get('name') == name:
+            return item
+    return None
+
+
+def diff_in_list(want, have):
+    return set(want) - set(have), set(have) - set(want)
+
+
+def parse_port(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.search(r'\budp-port\s+(\d+)\b', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_name(line, dest):
+    if dest == 'host':
+        match = re.match(r'^\s*logging host (?:ipv6 )?(\S+)', line)
+        if match:
+            return match.group(1)
+    return None
+
+
+def parse_address(line, dest):
+    return dest == 'host' and bool(re.match(r'^\s*logging host ipv6\s+\S+', line))
+
+
+def map_params_to_obj(module, required_if=None):
+    params = module.params
+    items = params.get('aggregate')
+    if items is None:
+        items = [params]
+    result = []
+    fields = ('dest', 'name', 'udp_port', 'facility', 'level', 'state')
+    for item in items:
+        obj = {key: item.get(key) if item.get(key) is not None else params.get(key)
+               for key in fields}
+        check_required_if(module, required_if, obj)
+        dest = obj['dest']
+        if count_terms(obj, ('dest', 'facility')) == 0:
+            module.fail_json(msg='dest or facility is required')
+        if dest not in DESTINATIONS and dest is not None:
+            module.fail_json(msg='invalid logging destination: %s' % dest)
+        if dest != 'host':
+            obj['name'] = None
+            obj['udp_port'] = None
+        else:
+            obj['addr6'] = validate_ip_v6_address(obj['name'])
+            if ':' in obj['name'] and not obj['addr6']:
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 host address: %s' % obj['name'])
+        if dest != 'buffered':
+            if dest == 'console' and obj['level'] is not None:
+                if obj['level'] not in LEVELS:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='invalid console logging level: %s' % obj['level'])
+            elif dest != 'console':
+                obj['level'] = None
+        else:
+            levels = obj['level'] if isinstance(obj['level'], (list, tuple, set)) else [obj['level']]
+            if not levels or any(level not in LEVELS for level in levels):
+                module.fail_json(msg='invalid buffered logging level')
+            obj['level'] = set(levels)
+        if obj['udp_port'] is not None:
+            port = str(obj['udp_port'])
+            if not port.isdigit() or not 1 <= int(port) <= 65535:
+                module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+            obj['udp_port'] = port
+        if obj['state'] is None:
+            obj['state'] = 'present'
+        result.append(obj)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    config = get_config(module, flags='| include logging',
+                        compare=module.params['check_running_config']) or ''
+    result = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    facility_explicit = False
+    on = True
+    console = True
+    console_level = None
+    buffered = None
+    for raw in config.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line.startswith('logging host '):
+            name = parse_name(line, 'host')
+            if name:
+                result.append(dict(dest='host', name=name,
+                                   udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                                   addr6=parse_address(line, 'host')))
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split(None, 2)[2]
+            facility_explicit = True
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+            facility_explicit = False
+        elif line == 'no logging on':
+            on = False
+        elif line == 'logging on':
+            on = True
+        elif line == 'no logging console':
+            console = False
+            console_level = None
+        elif line == 'logging console' or line.startswith('logging console '):
+            console = True
+            console_level = line.split()[-1] if line != 'logging console' else None
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffered = set()
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffered = set(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                if buffered is None:
+                    buffered = set()
+                buffered.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[-1]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                if buffered is None:
+                    buffered = set(LEVELS)
+                buffered.discard(level)
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            result.append(dict(dest='persistence'))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            result.append(dict(dest='rfc5424'))
+    result.append(dict(dest='facility', facility=facility, explicit=facility_explicit))
+    if on:
+        result.append(dict(dest='on'))
+    if console:
+        result.append(dict(dest='console', level=console_level))
+    if buffered is not None:
+        result.append(dict(dest='buffered', level=buffered))
+    return result
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    facility_obj = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'facility'),
+                        dict(facility='user', explicit=False))
+    current_facility = facility_obj['facility']
+    facility_explicit = facility_obj.get('explicit', current_facility != 'user')
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item['state']
+        facility = item.get('facility')
+        if facility is not None or dest is None:
+            if state == 'present' and facility is not None and current_facility != facility:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % facility)
+                current_facility, facility_explicit = facility, True
+            elif state == 'absent' and facility_explicit and (facility is None or facility == current_facility):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+                current_facility, facility_explicit = 'user', False
+        if dest is None:
+            continue
+        if dest == 'host':
+            candidate = search_obj_in_list(item['name'], have)
+            matches = ([h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'host' and h['name'] == item['name']
+                        and h.get('addr6', False) == item['addr6']]
+                       if candidate is not None else [])
+            port = item.get('udp_port')
+            if state == 'absent':
+                for old in matches:
+                    if port is None or port == old.get('udp_port'):
+                        commands.append('no ' + _host_command(old))
+                        have.remove(old)
+            elif not any(port is None or port == old.get('udp_port') for old in matches):
+                for old in matches:
+                    commands.append('no ' + _host_command(old))
+                    have.remove(old)
+                commands.append(_host_command(item))
+                have.append(item)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            old = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'buffered'), None)
+            enabled = old['level'] if old else set()
+            adds, _ = diff_in_list(item['level'], enabled)
+            levels = adds if state == 'present' else set(item['level']) - adds
+            for level in LEVELS:
+                if level in levels:
+                    commands.append(('logging' if state == 'present' else 'no logging') + ' buffered ' + level)
+            if old is None:
+                old = dict(dest='buffered', level=set())
+                have.append(old)
+            if state == 'present':
+                old['level'].update(adds)
+            else:
+                old['level'].difference_update(item['level'])
+        elif dest == 'console':
+            old = next((h for h in have if h['dest'] == 'console'), None)
+            if state == 'absent' and old:
+                commands.append('no logging console')
+                have.remove(old)
+            elif state == 'present' and (old is None or (item['level'] is not None and old.get('level') != item['level'])):
+                commands.append('logging console' + (' ' + item['level'] if item['level'] else ''))
+                if old is None:
+                    have.append(dict(dest='console', level=item['level']))
+                else:
+                    old['level'] = item['level']
+        else:
+            present = any(h['dest'] == dest for h in have)
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging ' + dest
+            if state == 'present' and not present:
+                commands.append(command)
+                have.append(dict(dest=dest))
+            elif state == 'absent' and present:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+                have[:] = [h for h in have if h['dest'] != dest]
+    return commands
+
+
+def _host_command(item):
+    command = 'logging host ' + ('ipv6 ' if item.get('addr6') else '') + item['name']
+    if item.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port ' + str(item['udp_port'])
+    return command
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='raw'),
+        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG']))
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                      ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+# Copyright: Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+from __future__ import absolute_import, division, print_function
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from units.compat.mock import patch
+from units.modules.utils import set_module_args
+from ansible.modules.network.icx import icx_logging
+from .icx_module import TestICXModule
+
+
+CONFIG = '''
+logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514
+logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514
+logging facility local7
+logging buffered
+no logging buffered debugging
+logging enable rfc5424
+no logging console
+no logging on
+'''
+
+
+class TestICXLoggingModule(TestICXModule):
+    module = icx_logging
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).setUp()
+        self.config_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.get_config')
+        self.get_config = self.config_patch.start()
+        self.get_config.return_value = CONFIG
+        self.load_patch = patch('ansible.modules.network.icx.icx_logging.load_config')
+        self.load_config = self.load_patch.start()
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.config_patch.stop()
+        self.load_patch.stop()
+        super(TestICXLoggingModule, self).tearDown()
+
+    def test_aggregate_changes_and_repeat(self):
+        args = dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::2', udp_port=514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level=['debugging', 'errors']),
+            dict(dest='console'),
+            dict(dest='on'),
+            dict(facility='local6')])
+        set_module_args(args)
+        commands = ['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::2 udp-port 514',
+                    'no logging host 192.0.2.1 udp-port 514',
+                    'logging buffered debugging', 'logging console',
+                    'logging on', 'logging facility local6']
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=commands)
+        self.load_config.assert_called_once()
+        self.get_config.return_value = '''
+logging host ipv6 2001:db8::2 udp-port 514
+logging facility local6
+logging buffered
+logging console
+logging on
+'''
+        set_module_args(args)
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_remove_ipv6_and_facility(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'),
+            dict(facility='local7', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='rfc5424', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='errors', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+            'no logging facility', 'no logging enable rfc5424',
+            'no logging buffered errors'])
+
+    def test_disabled_states_are_idempotent(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[
+            dict(dest='console', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='on', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.99', state='absent')]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])
+
+    def test_check_mode(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::3', _ansible_check_mode=True))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging host ipv6 2001:db8::3'])
+        self.load_config.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_required_parameters(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[dict(dest='buffered')]))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8:::bad'))
+        self.execute_module(failed=True)
+
+    def test_host_port_change(self):
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=514))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514',
+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 514'])
+
+    def test_helpers(self):
+        line = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 1514'
+        self.assertEqual(icx_logging.parse_name(line, 'host'), '2001:db8::1')
+        self.assertEqual(icx_logging.parse_port(line, 'host'), '1514')
+        self.assertTrue(icx_logging.parse_address(line, 'host'))
+        self.assertEqual(icx_logging.diff_in_list({'errors'}, {'warnings'}),
+                         ({'errors'}, {'warnings'}))
